response.reason: The TV is identifiable as a Samsung 80NU7020 UHD TV with HDR support, as confirmed by the on-screen menu in photo 1. The seller's claims about 4K UHD and HDR are supported. Hidden risks such as screen damage or non-functionality are possible but not visible; the item can be priced at its worst case (as having potential defects or not working) until further proof is provided.
